title: Uruguayan Comte Cheese Empanadas
description: Delicious and nutritious empanadas filled with a tangy Comte cheese mixture, perfect for a quick weeknight dinner or snack.
instructions: In a mortar and pestle, pound the onion until it is finely chopped.
In a large bowl, combine the flour, salt, and pepper.
Add the melted butter, egg, and Comte cheese to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Turn the dough out onto a floured surface and knead for 5 minutes.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Use a rolling pin to flatten each ball of dough into a thin circle.
Place about 1 tablespoon of the onion mixture onto one half of each circle.
Fold the other half of the circle over the filling and press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with a little bit of water and sprinkle with a pinch of salt.
Place the empanadas on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 20 minutes.
Serve the empanadas hot and enjoy!
